arguments.question: Do the supplied Q2 2026 results/guidance or latest 10-Q explicitly state that any China/Macau revenue, networking product, or policy-affected customer demand is excluded from Q3 guidance? Please distinguish an explicit exclusion from general tariff/supply-risk language and from second-order hyperscaler AI effects.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether policy exposure is already embedded as an excluded revenue item versus merely a conditional upside/downside channel over 5, 21 and 63 sessions.
